messages:
Alice M.: Heads up — rolling deploy to eu-west is throwing SDK signature mismatch errors for clients using SDK 3.2.1. Requesting a soft-unpin for 3.2.1 in eu-west and fallback to 3.1.8 until we have a hotfix.
Deploy-Bot: action required: pin-exemption request suggested. React with :thumbsup: to confirm.
Bob R.: can you paste a minimal error snippet?
Alice M.: here’s the error we’re seeing in logs:
```json
{"error":"SignatureMismatch","expected":"v1","got":"v1-alpha"}
```
Caroline L.: QA also flagged structured-output regressions with 3.2.1 in canary yesterday, might be related to the handshake change.
Dave S.: oncall here. My read: runtime/SDK handshake versioning drift. Recommend soft-unpin 3.2.1 in eu-west only, avoid global rollback.
Eva N.: ops can implement region-scoped pin quickly — will prepare deploybot change. ETA ~10m.
Deploy-Bot: received pin_request: add-exemption sdk=3.2.1 region=eu-west reason="SignatureMismatch" requested_by=Alice M.
Bob R.: also flag any models using the new wire format (function-calling/structured) — we should route them away from sdk=3.2.1 clients while this is investigated.
Caroline L.: can we limit the impact to affected model-groups only?
Dave S.: yes — we'll route model-group `semantic-embed` to runtime 2.14 in eu-west until patch lands. I'll create the canary routing rule.
Deploy-Bot: pin-exemption created id=pin-98765. Status: pending-approval.
Alice M.: approving. :thumbsup: 
Deploy-Bot: pin-exemption id=pin-98765 approved by Alice M. Applied: sdk 3.2.1 suspended in eu-west. Fallback routing enabled: model-group `semantic-embed` -> runtime 2.14.
Eva N.: ops: rolling config change is live. Monitoring logs and 5-min SLOs.
SRE-Bot: alert rule attached: if client error rate for sdk=3.2.1 > 2% for 5m we'll escalate; current error rate 1.8% and trending up.
Bob R.: created branch `sdk-compat/hotfix-signature` — will PR with handshake tolerance fix, estimate ~25-40m.
Caroline L.: draft release note: "eu-west: SDK 3.2.1 soft-unpinned due to signature mismatch; customers on 3.2.1 may see client errors. We will roll out SDK 3.2.2 with compatibility fixes shortly."
Deploy-Bot: added draft to draft_release_notes/1733339999.md and linked pin id=pin-98765.
Dave S.: timeline: monitor for 30m post-change, if stable we keep soft-unpin until patch; if regression continues we'll widen fallback. Will update this thread with any rollback decisions.
Alice M.: thanks all — tagging @Dave S. and @Eva N. for follow-up. If anyone sees new error classes, paste stack traces here.
